externalagency.title: External Agency
externalagency.remarks: If the audit is conducted by an external agency, specify the agency.

samplegroup.title: Sample Group
samplegroup.remarks: You can develop a sample group and assign a survey to that sample group. Then, you can analyze the responses from that sample group. All of the survey responses are calculated and displayed to authorized personnel as a summary at the header of the record.

techauth.title: Technical Authority Type
techauth.remarks: The type of technical authority that is associated with the certification that is required for the audit or the survey. Personnel who hold certifications in other operational areas might be required to review or approve the audit or the survey.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group that owns the audit and survey record. To change this value, use the Select Owner action.

reviewedby.title: Reviewed By
reviewedby.remarks: The person who reviewed the audit and survey record.

type.title: Type
type.remarks: The type of audit and survey record.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.remarks: The frequency of the audit or the survey.

externalaudit.title: External Audit
externalaudit.remarks: Indicates whether the audit is conducted by an external agency. If it is conducted by an external agency, specify the agency.

createdby.title: Created By
createdby.remarks: The person who created the audit and survey record.

policynum.title: Operating Policy
policynum.remarks: The operating policy that is associated with the audit or the survey.

regulationnum.title: Regulation
regulationnum.remarks: The regulation that is associated with the audit or the survey.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the audit and survey record.

details.title: Details
details.remarks: Detailed information about the audit and survey record.

completedby.title: Completed By
completedby.remarks: The person who completed the audit and survey record.

certreqd.title: Certification Required
certreqd.remarks: Indicates whether certification is required for the audit or the survey. You use certifications to ensure that assets or locations meet or exceed standards of quality and of safety. You also use certifications to make sure that personnel are qualified for specialized tasks.

plusgpertypeid.title: Permit and Certificate Type
plusgpertypeid.remarks: The type of permit and certificate that is associated with the audit or the survey.

approvedby.title: Approved By
approvedby.remarks: The person who approved the audit and survey record.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the site of the audit or the survey.

plusgpolicyid.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicyid.remarks: The identifier of the operating policy.

person.title: Person
person.remarks: The person who is responsible for conducting the audit or the survey.

plusgprocedureid.title: Operating Procedure
plusgprocedureid.remarks: The identifier of the operating procedure.

vendoraudit.title: Vendor Audit
vendoraudit.remarks: Indicates whether the audit is conducted by a vendor. If it is conducted by a vendor, specify the vendor.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the audit and survey record. Valid statuses are in the PLUSGAUDITSTATUS synonym domain. The default value when you create the audit and survey record is Draft. Use the Change Status icon on the toolbar to modify the status of the audit and survey.

template.title: Template
template.remarks: Indicates that the record can be used as a template to create other audit and survey records. Only certain fields and their values are duplicated. Those fields and their values are copied from the originating record to the new record. Some fields and their values, such as the fields in the Findings tab, are not duplicated. This is because the results of each audit or survey are unique to that audit or survey.

resultnum.title: Inspection Results
resultnum.remarks: The results of the audit survey.

completedbydate.title: Completed
completedbydate.remarks: The date and time when the audit and survey was completed.

totalscore.title: Total Score
totalscore.remarks: The total score is calculated from the combined scores that are associated with each line in the audit and survey record.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: A description of the audit and survey record.

surveyformat.title: Survey Format
surveyformat.remarks: Indicates whether a survey format is to be used for the audit or the survey. A survey format uses the Agree – Disagree response format.

approvedbydate.title: Approved
approvedbydate.remarks: The date and time when the audit and survey was approved.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: The asset that is associated with the audit and survey record.

plusgplandate.title: Planned
plusgplandate.remarks: The date when the audit or the survey is going to be conducted.

createdbydate.title: Created
createdbydate.remarks: The date and time when the audit and survey was created.

climatesurvey.title: Climate Survey
climatesurvey.remarks: Indicates whether a climate survey is to be done. When you select this option, you can assign a numerical value to each question. The total score displays in the summary of the header for the record. You can use a climate survey to record the opinions of personnel relating to the prevention of accidents in the work place. You can also use climate surveys to record the opinions of personnel relating to the management of the plant. You can tailor the questions to request suggestions for improvement.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The owner of the audit and survey record. You update this field through the Select Action > Select Owner action or the Select Action > Take Ownership action.

inspformrev.title: Current Form Revision
inspformrev.remarks: The revision number of the audit survey inspection form.

auditnum.title: Audit and Survey
auditnum.remarks: The identifier of the audit and survey record.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the audit and survey record was created, or when the status changed. This value is read-only.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the audit and survey record.

reviewedbydate.title: Reviewed
reviewedbydate.remarks: The date and time when the audit and survey was reviewed.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the audit and survey record, such as inspection, process, or safety.

inspformnum.title: Inspection Form
inspformnum.remarks: The identifier of the inspection form for the audit survey.
